P01.rationale: The founder (Jousef) is the dominant human anchor with a large, prominent portrait occupying the upper half of the page.

P05.rationale: While there are no specific case study portraits shown in this cover layout, the 'In diesem Report' section clearly frames and names the client (APEX Consulting) at a meaningful size.

P07.rationale: A strong social-proof apparatus is present via the prominent data callouts ('100+ AI-Projekte', '30-50% Kostensenkung') and the founder's name/title.

P10.rationale: There are oversized decorative typographic elements in the headline where 'FRISST' is emphasized with a large size shift and ghosted text behind it.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations are present in the form of specific numbers (100+, 30-50%) bound to business metrics like projects and cost reduction.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks, headlines, and imagery without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: There is an intentional background texture/atmosphere created by the dark, moody lighting and subtle gradients behind the founder portrait.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo of the founder is treated with a dark overlay/scrim so that the overlaid text remains readable against the busy background.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown; the focus is entirely on the person and abstract data points rather than physical artifacts.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business context (a founder in a professional setting) rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content from top to bottom.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a busy photo but uses effective darkening/scrimming techniques to ensure readability rather than awkward inset gaps.
